caption: The drawing is a detailed technical illustration of a piece of furniture, specifically a decorative console table, rendered in black ink on a yellowed, beige paper background. The central and largest object is a frontal elevation view of the table, showing elegant, curved legs with claw feet, ornate lever-like support brackets, and a rectangular body with decorative bows and swag motifs on the apron. Above the main image, there are two close-up rectangular panels showing detailed designs of the apron: the upper one features draped garland swags, and the lower one has a central ribbon bow detail. To the right of these, a circular perspective shows a rosette and molding detail, and below this is a side profile of one of the legs showing curve and ornamentation. Below the main table elevation are three more details: a front and side view of the claw foot with stylized leaf motifs, and a detailed “side view” of the bracket scroll. At the far right, there is a segmented side elevation of the table, including a zigzag break to indicate the continuation of length beyond the drawing. Handwritten dimensions (in inches) are included at the left, reading: height 34 1/2", width 25 1/4", length 68". The outermost border is a single-lined rectangle enclosing the technical illustration and notes. In the bottom right corner, there is a signature.
title: Sofa
